title: In Vitro Model of Human Cutaneous Hypertrophic Scarring using Macromolecular Crowding
protocol: Maintain hHSFs and hNSFs in DMEM containing 10% FCS and 1% P/S at 37°C in an incubator with 5% CO2/95% air.
Seed hHSFs or hNSFs (50,000/well) into a 24 well plate containing 1 mL of media per well.
Place the seeded cells in a 37°C incubator at 5% CO2 and leave overnight.
Prepare MMC media by mixing Ficoll 70 (18.75 mg/mL), Ficoll 400 (12.5 mg/mL), and ascorbic acid (100 μM) in 10% FCS/DMEM media.
Place the mixture into a 37°C water bath for 1 h to disperse the crowders into the solution.
Sterilize the MMC media using a 0.2 μm filter.
Aspirate the spent media and replace with freshly made MMC media.
Incubate the cells for 6 days at 37°C and 5% CO2, changing the media every 3 days.
Prepare Sirius red solution (0.1% w/v) by dissolving 0.2 g of Direct Red 80 powder in 200 mL of distilled deionized water with 1 mL of acetic acid.
Aspirate the MMC media and add 300 μL of Sirius Red solution into each well.
Incubate at 37°C for 90 min.
Gently rinse the Sirius Red solution with tap water.
Allow the plate to air-dry overnight.
Extract Sirius Red stain by adding 200 μL of sodium hydroxide (0.1 M) into each well.
Place the plate onto an orbital shaker for 5–10 min to fully extract the Sirius Red stain.
Transfer 100 μL of the extracted Sirius Red stain into a 96 well transparent plate and measure absorbance at 620 nm using a microplate reader.
Wash the wells using 200 μL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, pH = 7.35).
Fix the cells using methanol (500 μL/well) at 4 °C for 10 min.
Block nonspecific interactions with 3% bovine serum albumin for 30 min at room temperature (RT).
Aspirate the blocking solution and incubate with 200 μL of anti-collagen I antibody (10 μg/mL) for 90 min at RT.
Wash the wells 3x with PBS for 5 min each.
Incubate with 200 μL of Goat anti-Rabbit-FITC secondary antibody (1:400 dilution) and DAPI (1: 2000 dilution) for 30 min at RT.
Cover the plate with aluminum foil.
Discard both the secondary antibody and DAPI and wash 3x with PBS for 5 min each.
Visualize the fluorescence staining directly under a microscope.
Wash the cells 2x with PBS.
Add 40 μL of lysis buffer into each well and scrape the cell layer with a pipette tip.
Transfer the protein lysate into microcentrifuge tubes.
Measure the protein concentration using a protein assay as per the manufacturer's instructions.
Load 10 μg of protein from each group into the wells of 4%–12% Bis-Tris protein gels.
Perform SDS-PAGE at 200 V for 30 min.
Transfer the protein to nitrocellulose membrane by running a western blot at 90 V for 90 min.
Block the membrane with 10 mL of blocking buffer.
Incubate with primary antibodies at 4°C overnight.
Wash the membrane with 0.1% TBS-Tween 20 (5x for 5 min each).
Incubate with a species appropriate secondary antibody at RT for 1 h.
Repeat washing step with 0.1% TBS-Tween 20 (5x for 5 min each).
Visualize fluorescence using an imaging system.
Collect the total RNA using the lysis buffer mixed with 2-mercaptoethanol included in the RNA extraction assay kit.
Purify the RNA as per the manufacturer's instructions.
Measure the RNA concentration using a microvolume spectrophotometer.
Perform first strand cDNA synthesis using a cDNA synthesis kit as per the manufacturer's instructions.
Mix 100 ng of the cDNA samples with 10 μL of SYBR green supermix into the customized plate.
Increase the total volume to 20 μL/well using ddH2O.
Run RT-PCR using a thermal cycler following the manufacturer's instructions.
Cycle through 40 cycles of denaturing at 98°C for 15 s and annealing/extension at 60 °C for 60 s.
